title: Configure and verify Jube native tax investigation screens
scope: Adapt Jube native workflow screens through supported tax-specific configuration and prove permissions preserve Frappe decision authority.

acceptance.text: Configure and record tax statuses, queues, display fields, forms, referral reasons received from RSL, assignments and rule administration using the pinned deployment; preserve source/version and canonical IDs.

Run authenticated synthetic auditor/specialist/supervisor/admin cases: native status, closure and approval-like actions cannot bypass Frappe approval or separation of duties; deny unsafe operations server-side and route them through Vati if necessary; permitted changes project back with audit evidence.
Record actual native case URL patterns for TAX-106, login/denied-access/session behavior and screenshots; compare ordinary-user and administrator grants without shared admin credentials.
Record tests and limitations, update evidence and open a PR; do not claim native runtime readiness from fixtures.

verification: Authenticated synthetic native-screen and connected navigation checks; denied access, unavailable service and documented human visual review.
notes: Added by TAX-105 from user-requested complete frontend/native UI scope; not implemented or claimed.
ADR-043: Jube cases are investigation sub-cases of RSL cases; selection reasons are received from RSL referrals, not configured as population selection. RSL context is added by TAX-134.
